title: Neil the Seal Game
claim: Show HN: Neil the Seal Game
why_good: A quirky Show HN browser game that caught real attention — fun and viral, but a one-off game, not a startup.
value: Games monetize only via a hit franchise or platform; a single novelty game rarely becomes a company.
risk: Novelty spike; games are hit-driven, and this is a solo curiosity, not a durable business.
